parsed.post: Discarding the last run (0.986035) as it regressed from my best (0.985771). It seems the slight noise in the seed/shards impacted the result. I'll revert to the best known configuration (e7a8f46) and proceed with the plan to test a lower MATRIX_LR of 0.03 to find better stability.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to check if more conservative updates allow for better convergence on the depth-6, AR-64, WD-0.1 configuration.
